title: Akerley Reservoir: original rehabilitation approval scope

sources.publisher: Nova Scotia Utility and Review Board
sources.title: Board Decision Letter: Akerley Reservoir Rehabilitation Project
sources.locator: Exact matter M10446 → Key Documents → Public Board Decision Letter 85728

projectLink.basis: Staff report explicitly references M10446 and Mar 4/22; original letter independently verifies both. Akerley rehabilitation title corroborates the explicit link, not an amount-based match.

titles.interpretation: The staff label includes Design Work; the original approval describes the rehabilitation project, including potential floor work. Preserve both labels rather than silently renaming the report record or treating approval as design-only.

facts.label: Project and proposed funding source approved
Surpluses in closed, deferred or cancelled projects

approvalScope.basis: Pre-tender estimated project cost; Board approves project and proposed source of funds based on information provided.
approvalScope.floorProvision: Letter explains requested funding includes potential floor repairs and provisional pricing for full-floor replacement/rehabilitation if needed after inspection. It does not establish which floor work was ultimately necessary, tendered, paid or completed.
approvalScope.inspectionContext: Letter attributes the deferred pre-tender interior inspection to operational needs during another water-treatment project and winter draining/refilling risks; future inspection was planned. These are source-reported reasons, not independent delivery findings.
approvalScope.revisionScope: Letter describes an estimate increase from the earlier budget basis to the approved request; no separate earlier regulatory approval or later amendment was acquired.
approvalScope.conditions: No separately numbered conditions stated; approval qualification and provisional floor-work scope retained.

budgetComparison.explanation: Later staff project budget differs from original approval; revised allocation, scope, tax and amendment history have not been reconciled. No subtraction is presented as a saving, loss or overrun.

limits.scope: One exact original public decision letter and explicit accepted staff-report reference only. Original exhibits, later budget changes, contracts and payment records not acquired.

attribution: Institutional facts attributed to Nova Scotia Utility and Review Board and Halifax Water; no endorsement implied. Full-letter republication rights not established; signatures/contact details excluded.
